observable_requirements.contract: In default view ('all' / group selector), treemap node captions must be split into distinct styleable elements (bold resource title and dimmed size text) rather than a single flat text string. The root container node must not display a duplicate caption element.
Treemap visualization and the sidebar table must maintain non-overlapping layout where both remain visible and properly positioned side-by-side on sufficiently wide viewports.

Nodes within the same script bundle must share an identifiable base hue while varying in lightness/saturation across hierarchy depths so that nested submodules are visually distinguishable from parent modules.

preserved_behaviors: Existing URL option decoding, debug mode loading, and coverage red-shading in unused-bytes view mode must remain fully operational.
Error handling on malformed Lighthouse result payloads must continue reporting expected error strings.
behavioral_contract.implementation_variation: Color computation may use different exact HSL depth formulas or CSS custom properties as long as nested nodes exhibit discernible depth-based shade differences and root captions are omitted in group mode.

test_bundles.coverage_gap_reason: Existing Puppeteer tests verify data parsing and unused byte bar width, but completely lack assertions on caption DOM formatting (split title/size spans, root caption omission) and depth-based hierarchical node coloring.
test_bundles.why_assertions_measure_requirements: The assertions directly query the rendered caption element children to confirm distinct title and size elements and verify that nested child nodes receive different computed background colors than their depth-1 ancestor within the same bundle.
test_bundles.predicted_base_behavior: Base implementation renders flat single-string captions, does not remove the root caption in group mode, and assigns identical flat colors to all descendant nodes within a bundle regardless of depth.
test_bundles.predicted_reference_behavior: Base+patch correctly splits captions into title and size spans, removes the root caption, and renders distinct background colors for nested nodes across depth levels.
stable_test_ids: Lighthouse Treemap Visual Contract renders split captions and omits root caption
Lighthouse Treemap Visual Contract renders depth-dependent shades within bundles
environment_assumptions: Node.js with Puppeteer and Chrome installed
Treemap static assets built into dist/gh-pages/treemap prior to running test
test_bundles.equivalence_self_check: Any valid implementation that structures captions as multiple sub-spans and distinguishes child node shades from their parent node background passes without requiring exact private classnames or specific color math.
vacuous_pass_checks: Captions list must not be empty (totalCaptions > 0).
Nested nodes with parent must exist in debug fixture before evaluating background shades.
test_bundles.surface_signal_resistance: A superficial implementation that leaves captions as raw strings or keeps all bundle nodes at a single flat color fails because span count will be 0 and parent/child computed colors will match.
